design.objective: 三组浓度梯度,无阴性对照

sop.title: 三组浓度梯度,无阴性对照

steps.detail: Prepare materials & equipment per batch list; verify calibration records.
Prepare cell / enzyme / reagent solutions per recipe; record lot numbers.
Randomize units to groups per the randomization allocation table (seed recorded).
Apply treatment per group (negative control receives sham / vehicle only).
Record endpoint measurements at each sampling point using the data template columns.
Apply stop conditions / failure thresholds; record deviations in the deviation log.
Clean equipment, dispose of biological & chemical waste per safety plan.
Archive raw data, logs, and allocation table; store under the project data directory.

sop.next_action: resolve blocking issues (see blocking_issues) before field execution
